All New Adventures of Morph from Aardman Animations
By Peter Lord
Before Wallace & Gromit, Aardman Animations created Morph, one of their first
characters made of clay. The lovable morphing figure still has a cult following in
the U.K., and now, three decades later, Aardman is bringing Morph back to life
in a series of new episodes. Claymation will never die!

Kisa
By PyroPet
This is one of those projects that's so clever it makes you say to yourself, "Why
didn't I think of that?" On the outside, it's a cat candle. But once the wick is lit,
the melting wax begins to reveal the cat's skeletal structure. Kind of weird —
but pretty cute!

pixelstick - Light painting evolved.
By Bitbanger Labs
Innovative projects hit Kickstarter all the time, but we've never seen anything
like pixelstick. This mind-blowing LED tool allows people to transform their
photography by putting animations like this inside their images. It may just be
the most groundbreaking thing to happen to light painting in its 125-year
history!
